transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin underway so we can finalize the production package for the City Arts Gala. We've got the Saturday evening slot at the Orpheum, 900 seats, and the current draft has three cameras, festival archive reuse, a sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed. Before I can give binding production approval, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements. Let's start whenever you're ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure everyone is aware since it's not on Mara's current draft lock sheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue. The signed performance license I received this morning — which is now countersigned — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits any later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision allowing the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it is binding. The festival archive reuse as currently drafted cannot proceed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent constraints from the headliner's agent that I have confirmed in email but haven't yet entered into the production schedule. First, the headliner can only soundcheck at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — no other time is possible. Second, the performer's rider explicitly prohibits any sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's sponsor product display on stage provision. That sponsor display as currently drafted cannot proceed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement. My caption vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B — its dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general control-room location listed in the current draft plan will not work. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. Booth B must be assigned for the captioner on Saturday evening.
transcript.speaker: A5
